Container.Name: myhomecookin
Container.Overview: My Home Cookin' — the family recipe site. A mobile-friendly front end for Mealie: browse, cook from and add recipes (from a website link, a photo of a recipe card, or typed in). Mealie stays private on your network; expose only this container (e.g. with a Cloudflare Tunnel).

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port on Unraid for the site. Point the Cloudflare Tunnel at http://UNRAID-IP:this-port.

Config.Name: Mealie URL
Config.Description: Where this container reaches Mealie, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9925 (Unraid's IP and Mealie's host port). Mealie does not need to be on the internet.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on 'Add from a photo' (reads recipe cards with Claude). Leave empty to hide it.

Config.Name: Discord webhook: new recipes
Config.Description: Optional. Discord channel webhook URL (Edit Channel → Integrations → Webhooks). Posts the recipe name and who added it. Treat it like a password.
